## Purpose
A wrapper around Mistral's beta Connectors API, using direct async HTTP. Connectors are MCP servers registered with Mistral, which holds their credentials, lists their tools and runs them; nothing is proxied through this platform. The module also converts connector selections to and from agent tool specs, and renders the connector inventory for planning prompts.

## Responsibilities
- **`SCOPES`** are organization, workspace and user, broadest first, which is also the order in which they are resolved.
- **`_http_client`** is an `httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=https://api.mistral.ai, auth=MistralKeyAuth(), timeout=60)`.
- **`_fail(action, exc)`** turns httpx failures into a `MistralAPIError("Failed to <action>: <detail>")`:
  - the detail comes from the body's `detail` or `message`, or the text;
  - 4xx statuses are kept as they are, anything else becomes 502;
  - a `ConnectError` becomes 503 "cannot reach the Mistral API".
- **`_request(method, path, action, **kw)`** returns the decoded JSON, the text, or None for 204 or empty responses.
- **`_normalise(raw)`** gives every field the UI branches on a concrete default: id, name, title, description, server, icon_url, system_prompt, protocol (default "mcp"), visibility (default shared_org), `is_directory` (from `mistral: true`), is_authenticated, active, auth_type, supported_auth_methods, tool_count, created_at and modified_at.
- **`_normalise_tool(raw)`** returns `{name, description, parameters, required}`, reading the schema from `inputSchema`, `input_schema` or `parameters`. `_unwrap_list` pulls items from a list, or from the `data`, `items`, `connectors` or `tools` keys.
- **CRUD:**
  - `list_connectors(page_size, cursor)` returns `{items (sorted by name), count, next_cursor}`;
  - `get_connector`;
  - `create_connector(data)`:
    - the body is `{name, description, server}` plus icon_url, system_prompt, visibility and headers, and `auth_data{client_id, client_secret}` when both are set;
    - afterwards `_annotate_connector` records `provides_capability: capability.integration.read`, plus `serves_domain` when domains were given. This is best effort;
  - `update_connector` (PATCH with only the fields given; with none it just re-reads);
  - `delete_connector`.
- **Tools:**
  - `list_connector_tools` returns `[]` on failure, because an unconnected connector having no tools is a normal state;
  - `call_connector_tool(id, tool, args, credentials_name)` sends `POST /v1/connectors/{id}/tools/{tool}/call` with `{arguments}`;
  - `flatten_tool_result(result)`: MCP `{content: [...]}` collapses to a single text string, or text joined by "\n" when every block is text; otherwise the content list.
- **Auth:**
  - `get_auth_methods` (`GET .../authentication`);
  - `get_auth_url(id, credentials_name)` (`GET .../auth_url`) returns `{auth_url, ttl}`. It is fetched on demand because the URL lives about 10 minutes.
- **Credentials.** `list_credentials`, `set_credentials(name="default", credentials, is_default=True)` and `delete_credentials(credentials_name?)` call `/v1/connectors/{id}/{scope}/credentials`. An unknown scope raises 400.
- **Activation.** `set_activation(id, scope="organization", active, tool_configuration)` sends `POST /v1/connectors/{id}/{scope}/activate|deactivate`, with the `include`, `exclude`, `requires_confirmation` and `skip_confirmation` lists.
- **Agent specs:**
  - `build_connector_tool_specs(connectors)` turns each selection into `{"type": "connector", "connector_id", "tool_configuration"?: {include, exclude, requires_confirmation}}`. Plain id strings are accepted.
  - `extract_connector_refs(tools)` does the reverse.
- **`describe_for_prompt(scope)`:**
  - optionally filters by domain scope with `catalog.match.filter_subjects`; connectors with no annotation are kept;
  - skips inactive connectors and the connector named `document_library` (`_TOOL_EQUIVALENT_CONNECTORS`);
  - flags each connector `[directory]` or `[NOT AUTHENTICATED — do not attach]`;
  - returns `(markdown lines or "(none available)", ids)` and never raises.

See Responsibilities.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Direct HTTP instead of the SDK.** The beta surface moves faster than the pinned SDK, and several `client.beta.connectors.*` signatures do not match the documented request bodies.
- **Directory connectors** (installed from Studio) cannot be created or deleted through this API.
- **`document_library` is excluded from the connectors offered to planners.** It is a platform capability attached via `document_library_ids`. Offering it as a connector gave agents a generic search surface instead of a bound library.
- **Bearer-token connectors have no on-the-fly auth.** The credential must exist before an agent or workflow calls the connector.
